data.title: Design Quarter
data.about:
Discover the architectural masterpiece by Meraas, an iconic landmark in Dubai’s Design District, and be amazed. Get ready for an exclusive invitation to the prestigious d3 Design District as it welcomes you with open arms.

Join the privileged few and immerse yourself in the first residential development of the internationally acclaimed Dubai Design District. Experience Design Quarter at d3 a new standard of luxury living through our meticulously designed one-, and three-bedroom apartments. Prepare to be captivated by breathtaking vistas that will leave you in awe, while enjoying unmatched conveniences at your fingertips. Don’t let this extraordinary opportunity slip away. Embrace a lifestyle of elegance and sophistication by seizing the chance to elevate your living experience to new heights.

location_tile.title: Your new home will ensure you’re incredibly well-connected
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Enjoy a new residence in a premium location that guarantees outstanding connection. Experience the ease of being minutes from Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, DIFC, Dubai Mall, and all main motorways around Dubai Design District. Stay easily linked to the city’s pulse.

  • 10 Mins Downtown Dubai
  • 10 Mins Dubai Mall
  • 15 Mins Business Bay
  • 15 MIns DIFC
